$$150\text{ km} = \dfrac{18}{100}\times 150\text{ L} = 27\text{ L}$$

$$60 - 27 = 33\text{ L}$$

$$33\text{ L} = \dfrac{100}{15}\times 33 = 220\text{ km}$$

$$\text{MHR} = 220 - 48 = 172$$

$$\text{THR range} = 0.65\times 172 \text{ to } 0.85\times 172 = 111.8 \text{ to } 146.2$$

Wendy's THR is 112 – 146 bpm.

$$\dfrac{196}{P} = \dfrac{49}{130}$$

$$P = \dfrac{130\times 196}{49} = 520$$

The estimated number of penguins in the colony is 520.

$$P(\text{not flowers}) = 1 - 0.4 = 0.6$$

$$0.6\times 200 = 120$$

So 120 seeds are expected not to produce flowers.
